Equities Research Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for January, 30th (AAPL, ALGN, AMGN, APA, AX, BIIB, CE, COHR, CR, EMR) Posted by Donna Armstrong | Jan 30th, 2019
Equities Research Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Wednesday, January 30th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its hold rating reaffirmed by analysts at Maxim Group. The firm currently has a $160.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Services GM q/q & y/y trajectory disclosure paint a positive picture, but product GM trend is then even more concerning. Installed base disclosures are on a y/y basis, failing to assuage fears China iPhone installed base is now in decline. Guidance indicates further deterioration in business fundamentals. Reiterate Hold rating and 12-month price target of $160.”” Get Apple Inc alerts:

The firm currently has a $285.00 price target on the stock, down from their previous price target of $300.00. They noted that the move was a valuation call.
